text_block_list.text:
Нарита Таисин appears to be grouchier
than usual.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Nnngh, dammit! I'm gonna freakin'
EXPLODE!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Who cares what happened?! Ugh! Just thinking about it makes me mad!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
As I navigate through her ire, I manage
to get
Нарита Таисин to explain what's
going on.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Apparently, an Umamusume who lost to
her at a
scrimmage recently mocked her
for being small.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She was all like, "You got lucky this
time. But if
you don't get taller, you're
not gonna be able to
keep this streak
going, pipsqueak."
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Losing sucks—I get that. But talk
about
bad sportsmanship.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Seriously. I just can't catch a break...
That's been
bugging me this whole time.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Screw this! I'm gonna run laps till I drop
today!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: I'm heading to the track. Later.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: And with that, she runs off.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I meet up with Нарита Таисин later and
help her
train.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Huff, huff...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Not one bit. My blood's still boiling.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
I knew a regular training session
wouldn't be
enough for me. I'm gonna
train some more, so you
go on ahead
without me.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
choice_data_list: I actually think you should call it a day.
Yeah! Go big or go home!

text_block_list.text:
I knew a regular training session
wouldn't be
enough for me. I'm gonna
train some more, so you
go on ahead
without me.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
choice_data_list: I actually think you should call it a day.
Yeah! Go big or go home!

text_block_list.text:
Excuse you? Why the heck would I do
that?!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
choice_data_list:
Because it'll be bad if you overexert yourself
and get sick.

text_block_list.text: But!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
choice_data_list:
You'll just be proving that other Umamusume
right.

text_block_list.text:
I tell her how resting properly and
forgetting
about it is the best way to get
back at her
opponent.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: I guess you have a point.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Fine. I'll go home and get some sleЭпизод
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
I hate following your advice, but I hate
the idea
of her gloating over me even
more.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Anyway, I'm out.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Don't overdo it? Pfft. Like half-assed
training'll
do me any good.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
choice_data_list:
You should channel that energy into your next
race.

text_block_list.text:
Training to perfection and conquering
her next
race will feel so much better
than letting her
anger consume her now.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Upon explaining this to Нарита Таисин, a
wicked
grin spreads across her face.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Is that permission to grind that stupid
sore loser
under my heel and humiliate
her in our next
scrimmage?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Well, I'm gonna do it anyway. My rage
won't stop
unless I do.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Yeah. Sounds like a plan.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Just watch! I'm gonna make sure she
never
trash-talks me again!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: And so...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Well, duh!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
I'm not gonna feel any better with just a
leisurely
jog around the park!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: I'll run until I forget all about her!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: And so...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Raaahhh!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Yeah! I'm feeling pretty good already.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: All right, one more lap!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Argh!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: It's not enough. I'm still mad as hell!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: But I can't move anymore...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Ugh...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
With her fighting spirit ablaze, Narita
Taishin
devises a plan to put the sore
loser in her place.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The next day, Нарита Таисин's anger has
subsided
completely. It seems resting
properly did her
some real good.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Таисин's rage is potent fuel, and
she
continues her solo training for a long
while
afterward.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Таисин burns herself out and sits
there on
the spot, unable to stand...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
